title: Executor: split repair must not destroy history on failed re-download
description: BUG: _check_and_apply_splits deletes a ticker's entire history BEFORE re-downloading. When the batch re-download returns empty/failed for a ticker (transient yfinance failure), that history is permanently lost — happened on 2026-09-10 to BKNG, BWA, FNF, FTAI, LOGI, RLI (left with only 2 rows). FIX (option 2): in both src/ingestion.py and src/ingestion_challenger.py, change ordering to (1) batch download first, (2) for each affected ticker only delete+upsert if the re-downloaded frame actually contains rows for that ticker; if a ticker is missing/empty in the re-download, keep its existing data and warn (do NOT record its splits as processed — leave them unprocessed so a later run can retry). Splits already recorded in bulk before the download should be reverted/skipped for failed tickers, or better: only record splits for tickers that were successfully re-downloaded. title: Executor: fix scheduled-task timezone + silent failure exit code
description: Challenger findings on F7-T11: (1) HIGH timezone bug — schtasks /st uses machine-local time but register_daily_task.ps1 copies scheduler.schedule_time verbatim while config timezone is America/New_York; on a GMT machine the task fires 16:14 UK = 11:14 ET mid-session producing partial intraday bars. (3) MEDIUM unhandled exceptions go to stderr which Task Scheduler discards — wrap main() so all tracebacks land in the configured log file before exit(1). (4) honor cfg.logging.log_format like scheduler_main._configure_logging. After editing, re-run register_daily_task.ps1 to refresh the live task (verify with schtasks /query).
